turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was my son's essay given a zero before anyone called me?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, a written explanation of who decided to enter it before I was called, and written confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal's office still ahead of her, and she agreed to nothing; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it because the meeting ended before you spoke.
What moved her: Nothing, because you did not get to say or show anything before the meeting was ended.
What cost ground: Nothing, because you made no move that she could count for or against you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went into the gradebook before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her before you say anything about the checker.
